name: Single Arm Pushdown
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high pulley.
Hold it with one hand and pin your elbow at your side.
Press down until your arm is straight.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A single-arm cable pushdown that isolates one triceps at a time.
